name: provider_adapter
invariants: Only a selected Route Decision enters the Provider Adapter boundary.
Request, registry, and Provider runtime config use the same tenant_id and config_version.
Upper layers provide only an opaque provider_id and never depend on endpoint, secret_ref, Provider model, or plaintext credential.
The adapter resolves internal runtime config and secret_ref inside the infrastructure boundary.
Provider-specific responses and errors are normalized into stable structured results.
One boundary invocation performs one Provider attempt; retry and fallback orchestration is delegated to its versioned boundary.
The online Data Plane path never queries Control Plane PostgreSQL.
Usage, Billing, Audit, and Analytics persistence never blocks Provider invocation.
